spec.title: Add Document Symbol Provider for plan.xml files to enable Outline view navigation
spec.context:
When viewing plan.xml files in VSCode, users must scroll through raw XML to find sections like tasks, testing, or edge cases. The XML structure is verbose and hard to navigate. There's no way to quickly jump to a specific implementation task or see at a glance which tasks are completed vs pending. Users waste time scrolling and searching instead of navigating directly to the section they need.
This feature enables instant navigation within plan.xml files using VSCode's built-in Outline panel. Users can see the full plan structure at a glance, see task completion status (checkmark vs circle), and click any item to jump directly to that line. Also enables breadcrumb navigation at the top of the editor and Ctrl+Shift+O quick symbol search. No new UI needed - leverages existing VSCode infrastructure.

in-scope.item: Hierarchical symbol tree showing: plan root, sections (tasks, testing, edge-cases, pitfalls, notes), task items
Status indicators for tasks using unicode prefix (checkmark for completed, circle for pending)
Click-to-jump navigation with accurate line positions
Breadcrumb navigation support (automatic via DocumentSymbol hierarchy)
Ctrl+Shift+O quick symbol picker support (automatic via DocumentSymbolProvider registration)
Integration with existing file watcher for refresh on file changes

out-of-scope.item: Support for task.xml or spec.xml files (plan.xml only)
Custom icons or colors (using native VSCode theme)
Tree view in sidebar (using Outline panel only)

functional.item: The system shall register a DocumentSymbolProvider for files matching pattern **/.kanban/tasks/*/plan.xml
The system shall display a hierarchical symbol tree with plan root as the top-level symbol showing task ID and title
The system shall display section symbols (tasks, testing, edge-cases, pitfalls, notes) as children of the root
The system shall display task items as children of their respective sections with SymbolKind.Method
The system shall prefix completed task labels with checkmark (U+2713) and pending tasks with circle (U+25CB)
The system shall provide accurate line ranges for each symbol to enable click-to-jump navigation
The system shall limit nesting depth to 3-4 levels maximum
The system shall truncate symbol labels to 60 characters, appending "..." if longer
The system shall return empty symbol array on parse error, logging warning to console
The system shall refresh symbols when plan.xml file changes (via existing file watcher integration)

non-functional.item: Symbol generation shall complete within 100ms for typical plan files
The implementation shall follow Capability/Computer separation pattern
The implementation shall use Factory-DI pattern for testability

Register provider in extension.ts composition root using vscode.languages.registerDocumentSymbolProvider(). Reference: apps/vscode/src/extension.ts:138-143
Use fast-xml-parser with ignoreAttributes: false, attributeNamePrefix: '', textNodeName: '_text'. Reference: apps/vscode/src/computers/task-parser.computer.ts:8-12
Create EventEmitter for symbol change events, return refresh callback, coordinate with file watcher. Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/codelens.capability.ts:21-22, 58-60

pitfall.mitigation: Try-catch with empty return - wrap parser in try-catch, return empty symbols on error, log warning
Full nesting with limit - show full hierarchy but cap at 3-4 levels max
Semantic mapping table: sections to Class, task groups to Namespace, tasks to Method, items to Property
Unicode label prefix - prepend checkmark (U+2713) for completed, circle (U+25CB) for pending
Hybrid approach - parse XML structure with fast-xml-parser, then line-scan to map element positions
Full hierarchy - show all symbols, rely on type-ahead filtering to narrow results
No debouncing - let VSCode handle it, DocumentSymbolProvider is called on-demand
Truncate at 60 chars - limit labels to 60 characters, append ... if longer
Register with onDidChangeDocumentSymbols event and extend existing file watcher pattern
Limit hierarchy to 3-4 levels to avoid clutter
Wrap all logic in try-catch, return empty array on error, log to console
Return empty symbols gracefully, do not error

constraints.constraint: File scope: Only plan.xml files (not task.xml or spec.xml)
Must follow Capability/Computer pattern with factory-DI, orchestrated by tasks.orchestrator.ts
Must use VSCode ThemeColors and native patterns (per design directive)
DocumentSymbol.range must point to exact line for editor jump
Breadcrumb and Ctrl+Shift+O automatically provided by VSCode when DocumentSymbolProvider is registered
